question:
A social media platform's user system is designed as follows:
The platform has users. User information includes User ID, First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Avatar Path, Password, and Date of Birth.
Users can post posts. Post information includes Post ID, Poster User ID, Post Title, and Post Content.
Users can also comment on posts. Comment information includes Commenter User ID, Commented Post ID, and Comment Content.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0334
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `first_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `last_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email_address` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `avatar_path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `password` char(255) NOT NULL,
  `date_of_birth` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `posts` (
  `post_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `poster_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `post_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `post_content` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`post_id`),
  KEY `posts_ibfk_1` (`poster_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`poster_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `comments` (
  `comment_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `commenter_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `commented_post_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `comment_content` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`comment_id`),
  KEY `comments_ibfk_1` (`commenter_user_id`),
  KEY `comments_ibfk_2` (`commented_post_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`commenter_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`commented_post_id`) REFERENCES `posts` (`post_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
